claim_fields.integration_demonstration: Supplied candidate lifecycle, checked use, fresh-process replay and controls; not discovery.
claim_fields.auto_schema_induction: Machine training-trace induction, verified input isolation/seal order, same candidate generalized to holdout and dual-replayed.
claim_fields.bounded_search_gain: At least three paired baseline misses versus treatment successes under identical sealed scheduler budgets, restored by ablation.
claim_fields.full_target: All experimental fields PASS plus complete regression gate and no red-team blocker.

deadline_rule: Freeze approved UTC deadline at launch; use the earlier of deadline and launch + 16 hours.

dependency_rules.normal: Required task supplies READY, or an explicitly accepted typed failure where a separate weaker profile permits it; never silently skip a required proof/checker.
dependency_rules.foundation_optional: F1/F2 not needed only with a probe-backed NOT_NEEDED receipt.
dependency_rules.start_vs_acceptance: Real-input dependencies do not block stub-based implementation; acceptance is evaluated on an assembled candidate, avoiding false implementation cycles.
dependency_rules.foundation_report: After CL0R selects FOUNDATION_ONLY, REL may emit the foundation report without experimental-task completion; all experimental verdicts BLOCKED.
dependency_rules.induction_failure: Both attempts must yield a seal/failure report for evaluation; one whole passing candidate may satisfy induction; all attempts remain visible.
dependency_rules.ready_semantics: READY means owned patch and stub/unit evidence are merge-ready. Listed real-input cross-checks run on the wired integration candidate; a mutual cross-check is not a task-launch dependency. Final PASS requires real evidence, not stubs.
dependency_rules.contract_seal_bootstrap: During CL1 the evidence role performs the small seed/split/capability freeze using native fixture construction and host artifact I/O; this does not wait for the complete CL7 harness.
dependency_rules.full_target_induction: CL10 integration readiness does not require induction PASS; REL must report both induction attempts and cannot grant full_target PASS without actual induction acceptance.

constraints.shared_changes_require: minimal symbol/line-specific proposal, consumer, persistence need and failing acceptance probe
constraints.git_writer: integrator only on fixed session branch; isolated worker source copies contain no .git
constraints.runtime_representation: machine-native terms; no Python containers/booleans as Machine state or solver
constraints.artifacts: generated data/snapshots/large logs outside Git; small durable receipts and reproduction commands only
constraints.checkpoint_rule: candidate and trusted primitive rules stay separate; never remove a primitive axiom and then reuse its macro as if trusted
constraints.approved_environment: release probes use operator-approved target interpreter; Linux diagnostic evidence is not target release evidence
constraints.private_inputs: Never commit holdout/seed/reserve values; only evaluator-owned storage outside Git. Public protocol fixture paths contain commitments and generation metadata.

budget_v1.metric_qualification: Scheduler dispatch budget, not total compute or wall-clock speedup; bound and report primitive replay/matching work too.

corpus.selection_rule: First executable family satisfying the sealed structural contract, before candidate evaluation. Family 2 is a declared synthetic fallback, not new mathematical evidence.

families.scored_corpus_rule_set: One frozen primitive set; conformance relabelings regenerate candidates from their own traces and use separate trusted-rule digests.

corpus.integration_development_split: Separate from induction holdout; fixture candidate inaccessible to generators.

formal_semantics.ORDER_SIGN_TWO_STEP: Whole-term unary rewriting in a free constructor algebra, using only the sealed two primitives; positivity is an assumption, not a host numerical predicate.
formal_semantics.DECLARED_RELATIONAL_CALCULUS: Finite sets of positive ground facts; consistent conjunctive premise substitution, add conclusion; atomic fact-query goal; no consumptive knowledge-board mode.
formal_semantics.normalization: No implicit arithmetic or unrecorded normalization; native-path disagreement blocks or prospectively re-scopes before feature dispatch.
formal_semantics.role_mapping: Explicit schema-role to rule-local-variable mappings per action; equal variable-name text across rules is insufficient.

acceptance_inventory.assertion: Approved environment and exact SHA/tree; active import and named scratch-source exception ledger.
Complete existing test inventory and semantic verdicts; deliberately failed case makes the adapter nonzero.
Character, loaded variable, shared-child and declared-label snapshot round trips.
Pre-save semantic derivation readers and fresh-process constructor/replay preservation; dynamic roots are not namespace-name aliases.
Bounded pilot entry point with no old worker/comparison evidence inherited.
Repeatable approved baseline; unresolved timeout/exception/coverage blocks release.
Exact versioned machine record shapes and malformed version/kind/arity rejection.
Repeated-role identity/consistency and all conclusion roles bound.
Frozen family, primitive rules, candidate absence, split and budget digests.
Six Machine-generated traces, at least three assignments, a two-step fragment, a generalized bound role and provenance.
Generator denied fixture-candidate/holdout/reserve/peer-output access; both seals precede evaluator exposure.
Five unseen positives dual-checked; same candidate used in at least three; no exact training-proof reuse.
Near misses reject; generic renaming/structural variants; every emitted or failed attempt reported.
Valid expanded proof accepted by both independent checkers; continuity and final goal checked.
Premise, conclusion, rule, repeated-role binding, intermediate-state and foreign-goal mutations rejected.
Foreign primitive rule rejected even inside a plausible action or supplied registry.
Malformed, unbound, unknown, cyclic and over-limit proof fails closed.
No checker calls search, proof replay/builders or induction; disagreement blocks release.
Corrupted expansion rejected by both checkers.
Dispatch, expanded-step, substitution/matching and wall ceilings enforced; costs reported separately.
Valid candidate checked and admitted only for the session after evidence exists.
Absent/rejected admission or wrong candidate digest, experiment, scope or SHA cannot activate.
No durable promotion or trusted store/pack changes.
Concrete residual plus dependency request survives checkpoint.
Parse, binding, no-rule, budget, checker and safety failures classified distinctly.
Reordered facts/duplicates/distractors preserve valid class; missing information changes failure appropriately.
Actual state cold-loaded in a fresh process and both checkers re-run with equivalent normalized verdicts.
Scope, aliasing and semantic constructors preserved; stale experiment/SHA fails closed; no fallback registration.
Interrupted checkpoint write preserves previous checkpoint or reports explicit recovery failure.
One command grades requested conjunction and completeness/hashes; missing/corrupt receipt makes it nonzero.
Three clean repetitions yield equal normalized verdict vectors.
Ablation clears candidate-derived state; same primitives/budget; three paired misses recur for the gain claim.
Source/fixture/scope mismatch, leakage, unverified isolation or post-seal refinement blocks the appropriate claim.
Stubbed complete success and every terminal failure edge.
Duplicate delivery idempotent; stale delivery rejected; prompt attempt/refusal never continues.
Typed failure and dependency request persisted without human candidate selection.
No core edit, forbidden touched-path construct, fixture branch, pack answer, normal-search regression or fallback repair.
